name: America the Beautiful — Military Lifetime Pass
det: Free lifetime entrance pass to 2,000+ federal recreation sites for veterans and Gold Star Families. Covers everyone in the vehicle.
elig: All veterans (any era) and Gold Star Family members

name: USACE Day-Use Recreation Areas
det: Free day-use access (boat ramps, swim beaches, picnic areas) at Corps-managed lakes nationwide for veterans and Gold Star Families.
elig: Veterans, Gold Star Families, active duty

name: Alabama State Parks — Disabled Veteran Discount
det: Discounted/free day-use admission and camping discounts for Alabama resident disabled veterans at 21 state parks.
elig: AL residents with service-connected disability (bring VA rating letter)

name: Gulf State Park (Gulf Shores, AL)
det: Military/veteran discounts on lodge stays, camping, and beach pavilion rentals on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
elig: All veterans & active duty with ID

name: Oak Mountain State Park (Birmingham, AL)
det: Alabama's largest state park — discounted entry for veterans; trails, lakes, cabins 20 minutes from Birmingham VA.

name: U.S. Space & Rocket Center
det: Military and veteran admission discounts at the official NASA visitor center next door to Redstone Arsenal.
elig: Veterans, active duty, dependents with ID

name: Disney Armed Forces Salute
det: Deeply discounted multi-day Military Promotional Tickets and room rates; eligible veterans 100% P&T included via Shades of Green eligibility.
elig: Active duty, retirees, 100% P&T veterans (verify current program year)

name: Waves of Honor — SeaWorld / Busch Gardens
det: One complimentary admission per year for active duty + 3 guests; veteran discount tickets offered seasonally.

name: Six Flags Military Discount
det: Discounted gate admission and seasonal free-ticket events for service members and veterans at participating parks.
elig: Military/veteran ID at gate or online verification

name: MWR Information, Tickets & Travel (ITT)
det: On-base ITT offices broker discounted tickets to water parks, theme parks, and attractions nationwide — now open to veterans with a service-connected rating under DoD/VA expanded access.
elig: Active duty, retirees, and service-connected disabled veterans

name: National Park Free Entrance Days
det: Fee-free days for all visitors including Veterans Day; pairs with the lifetime military pass for year-round access.

name: Commissary / Exchange / MWR — Expanded Access
det: Veterans with any service-connected rating, Purple Heart recipients, former POWs, and primary caregivers shop commissary/exchange and use MWR retail facilities.
elig: Service-connected rating (any %) — VHIC or rating letter

name: Lake Guntersville State Park (AL)
det: Veteran discounts on lodge, golf, and camping at Alabama's premier lake park — 40 minutes from Redstone Arsenal.
